constituentArticles.title: SEBI proposal for SWP and STP in demat mutual funds
constituentArticles.text: SEBI proposed allowing standing instructions for Systematic Withdrawal Plans (SWP) and Systematic Transfer Plans (STP) for demat mutual fund units.
